readme_quotes: Isaac Lab is a GPU-accelerated, open-source framework designed to unify and simplify robotics research workflows, such as reinforcement learning, imitation learning, and motion planning. Built on NVIDIA Isaac Sim.
pip_installation.rst: 'pip install -U torch==2.7.0 torchvision==0.22.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128' (Linux x86_64)
src_symlink_isaacsim.rst: 'ln -s ${ISAACSIM_PATH} _isaac_sim' — create symlink to binary install directory
isaaclab.sh -i block: '${pip_command} setuptools<82.0.0' — prescribed by isaaclab.sh install sequence
isaaclab.sh -i block: 'find -L source -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -exec install_isaaclab_extension' — installs all source/ extensions editable
isaaclab.sh -i block: '${pip_command} -e source/isaaclab_rl[all]' and '${pip_command} -e source/isaaclab_mimic[all]' — install RL and mimic frameworks
pip_python_virtual_env.rst (UV section): 'uv venv --python 3.11 --seed env_isaaclab' (note: we use 3.10 for Isaac Sim 4.5 binary which ships Python 3.10)
ambiguities: Docs show two Isaac Sim install paths: (A) pip install isaacsim[all,extscache] from pypi.nvidia.com, (B) binary install + _isaac_sim symlink. User has Isaac Sim 4.5 binary at /home/steven/Downloads/...; this plan uses path B (symlink).
isaaclab.sh calls ensure_cuda_torch which would install torch==2.7.0+cu128 for x86_64. We replicate this directly as a uv pip install step.
isaaclab_contrib has no install_requires; installed for completeness since isaaclab.sh -i installs all source/ subdirs.
Python version: Isaac Sim 4.5 binary ships Python 3.10; venv must be 3.10 (system python3.10 available at /usr/bin/python3.10). Docs confirm: 'For Isaac Sim 4.X, the required Python version is 3.10.'
